integrity.mathematical_evidence: Closed labeled-species coefficient proof, explicit product-idempotence criterion, and independent finite brute-force checks.

scientific_limitations: Counts ordered labeled idempotent factors with an idempotent composition; no claim for individual factorization fibers, arbitrary partial transformations, or longer products.
